tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Chrome, carries no finding.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Card and callout surface, one step off the paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text; the hub's 2px border.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dek, card rows, glosses.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Labels, kind tags, metadata. Use at 11px+ in mono caps only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus rings, footnote numbers. Structure only, never a finding.

tokens.name: g-doc
tokens.usage: Documented grade: solid line, chip text. A primary document shows the link.

tokens.name: g-rep
tokens.usage: Reported grade: dashed line, chip text. One party's own word or the press.

tokens.name: g-rep-ink
tokens.usage: Reported chip text. The line amber is under 4.5:1 as small text; darkening the line instead would merge it with sanction red for deuteranopes.

tokens.name: g-open
tokens.usage: Not documented grade: dotted line, chip text. A gap, not an alarm.

tokens.name: g-open-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Not documented chip.

tokens.name: sanction
tokens.usage: The Sanctioned flag only. The only red on a page; the flag always names the regimes.

tokens.name: hub-edge
tokens.usage: TsBST (ЦБСТ) hub card border: marked by weight, not hue.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: «Bulat» from TsBST to the front line

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: A name on a chain card, Latin first (STYLE_GUIDE §2.2-2.3); the registered Cyrillic name sits beneath it.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: «Всю нашу продукцию можно приобрести только у нас на сайте 3mx.ru»

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Portable UAV detector made by 3mx (OOO «Trimiks»), a company under sanctions.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bought by state agencies under 3 contracts.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: As reported by the donor on its own Telegram channel.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, column heads, kind tags; uppercase.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: ИНН, ОГРН, в/ч numbers: bare digits, tabular.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label; legend item gap.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, quotes, callouts. Chips use 3px. Square-ish on purpose: these are documents.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Cards only. Callouts, quotes and absent cards carry none.
